title: Ores Of Plentiness
description: This mod aims to include more ores, currently there is 40+
body:
Tired of exploring dull caves filled with the same old ores? **Ores of Plentiness** brings life back underground by adding a wide variety of unique ores, each with its own custom blocks, tools, and materials to master.

With vibrant new resources to uncover and craft, every mining trip becomes a fresh adventure — no two caves will ever feel the same again.

### What can you do with the ores?

* Craft functional machines such as batteries
* Forge stronger tools and armor to enhance your progression
* Build with brand-new decorative blocks
* Harness special ores to unlock access to a new dimension
